label: TP
reason: Two distinct vulnerabilities identified: (1) Insecure randomness - java.util.Random is used for generating rememberMeKey (line 50), providing insufficient entropy for sensitive tokens; (2) Reflected XSS - user input from request parameter flows through doSomething() without proper HTML escaping and is written directly to response output (lines 89-94), allowing script injection.

evidence.note: Uses java.util.Random for generating rememberMeKey - insufficient cryptographic strength for sensitive tokens
User input concatenated directly into HTML response without sanitization - enables XSS
